units.source_text: 当时，我们一家四口围在仓库的饭桌旁吃晚饭。

en.t: At the time, the four of us in the family were gathered around the dining table in the storehouse, eating supper.

units.source_text: 其实，母亲还躺在床上，只是微微扬起头来而已，算不得围在饭桌旁。

en.t: In truth, Mother was still lying in bed and had only raised her head slightly, so she could hardly be said to be gathered around the table.

units.source_text: 但是，那天晚上的晚饭比过去任何时候都明朗。

en.t: But supper that night was brighter than it had ever been before.

units.source_text: 因为闪亮的新油灯代替了昏暗的老式无尽灯。

en.t: That was because a shining new oil lamp had replaced the dim old endless lamp.

units.source_text: 哥哥和我在吃饭的间隙，总是不由的时不时看向油灯。

en.t: Between bites, my elder brother and I could not help glancing again and again at the oil lamp.

units.source_text: 透过玻璃壶形状的灯罩，能够清楚的看见里面的煤油，

en.t: Through the glass, pot-shaped shade, we could clearly see the kerosene inside,

units.source_text: 火焰被灯罩保护着不至于胡乱晃动——真是美丽神奇的油灯啊！

en.t: and the flame, protected by the shade, did not flicker wildly. What a beautiful, marvelous oil lamp it was!
